title: Alhazem Tech — Company Profile
service: Company profile booklet, layout system, print
blurb: A 20-page profile that had to convince distributors, not designers. Clean 12-column grid, one accent per spread, and data that reads as confidently as the photos.
alt: Alhazem Tech company profile booklet mockup with blue spreads and grid layout
details: Grid documented on a single reference page so the client can extend it in-house.
Blue kept as the only accent; imagery is the only other decoration.
Two versions: print (bleed, CMYK) and a lighter-screen PDF for email.
